papers.title: The Midas Touch for Metric Depth: Interpretable Metricization for Generalizable Depth Perception
papers.reason: metric depth estimation；可将船舶单目相对深度先验通过分段仿射尺度恢复转换为度量深度，并利用稀疏船舶测距或雷达深度观测沿最小几何变化路径进行像素级传播；需要将16个通用数据集的训
papers.abstract: Recent foundation models have drastically improved the generalization of monocular relative depth estimation, yet recovering accurate metric depth from their estimates for depth perception tasks remains challenging due to scale ambiguity and local metric-scale inconsistency. Existing approaches recover metric depth from sparse observations using either explicit global affine transformation algorithms or implicit data-driven depth completion networks. The former cannot accommodate spatially varying relative-to-metric relationships, while the latter are sensitive to the distribution of sparse observations and may not fully exploit generalizable relative depth priors. To simultaneously address these issues, this study extends our previous work MTD and proposes MTDv2, a hybrid metric depth perception framework that combines explicit depth metricization with data-driven metric depth refinement. The explicit depth metricization process performs segment-wise affine transformations to recover spatially varying metric scales while preserving the geometric structure of relative depth, followed by pixel-wise depth refinement that propagates metric observations along paths with minimal accumulated geometric variation. The data-driven depth refinement process subsequently extends the explicit single-path depth propagation to a learnable multi-path formulation while preserving its interpretability. Extensive experiments conducted on 16 public datasets demonstrate the robust and generalizable depth scale recovery capability of MTDv2 across diverse sources of sparse observations and different depth estimation paradigms, as well as its broad applicability to downstream 3D perception tasks. Code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/MTD upon publication.

papers.title: SARFusion: Scene-Aware Routing Fusion for Robust Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection
papers.reason: robust camera-LiDAR 3D object detection via scene-aware branch routing fusion；可设想把场景可靠性先验与逐查询分支路由移植到
papers.abstract: Camera-LiDAR fusion has become a prevailing paradigm for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. However, existing fusion detectors often establish strong inter-modality dependencies by decoding object queries from tightly coupled multimodal representations. Under corrupted driving conditions, such dependencies make the detector vulnerable to unreliable modalities, where degraded observations may interfere with reliable modality-specific evidence and lead to suboptimal predictions. Moreover, modality reliability can vary across both global driving scenes and individual object queries, requiring adaptive fusion decisions at a finer granularity. To bridge this gap, we reformulate robust camera-LiDAR fusion as a scene-aware branch routing problem and propose SARFusion, a robust 3D object detector. Instead of producing detections from a single fused representation, SARFusion decouples object-query decoding into three parallel reasoning branches: a camera branch, a LiDAR branch, and a camera-LiDAR fusion branch. Guided by a Scene Reliability Prior estimated from the global driving context, SARFusion further incorporates object-level evidence to route each query to the most suitable branch. This query-wise routing strategy alleviates harmful cross-modal interference while preserving the benefits of multimodal fusion when complementary cues are trustworthy. On the nuScenes test set, SARFusion achieves strong performance with 72.5 mAP and 74.4 NDS. Extensive analyses demonstrate its robustness under challenging conditions, including sensor corruptions and environmental changes.

papers.title: When LiDAR Fades, Radar Takes Over: LiDAR Reliability-Aware Adaptive Localization Under Airborne Obscurants
papers.reason: LiDAR退化检测与雷达/LiDAR自适应定位；可将LiDAR可靠性估计门控从定位模态切换调整为多传感器检测中的视觉/雷达分支加权或切换：输入改为各传感器检测特征及质量线索，训练目标改为正常/退化状态
papers.abstract: LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) is widely used for real-time localization and mapping, but its reliability can degrade substantially in subterranean environments affected by smoke, dust, and other airborne obscurants, whereas radar remains comparatively robust. This article presents a one-class temporal learning framework for LiDAR degradation detection and reliability-aware localization under such conditions. A broad set of degradation-sensitive cues, including spatial, cross-modal, geometric/motion, intensity, and measurement-recency features, is evaluated to characterize changes in LiDAR sensing quality. Their temporal evolution is modelled over sliding windows using an LSTM autoencoder trained exclusively on nominal operation, enabling deviations from healthy sensor behaviour to be detected without requiring labelled degradation data. The resulting LiDAR reliability estimate governs adaptive selection between LIO and radar inertial odometry (RIO), retaining LIO during reliable sensing and transferring localization authority to RIO when degradation is detected. The framework is evaluated using real-world ground robot data collected in GNSS-denied subterranean tunnels under nominal and dense-smoke conditions. Experimental results demonstrate degradation detection, adaptive modality switching, and continued localization output under severe LiDAR degradation. A feature family ablation study further shows that a reduced feature representation can improve degradation-aware localization performance in the evaluated dense-smoke scenarios, highlighting the importance of feature parsimony in one-class sensor degradation detection. The code will be released as open source to support reproducibility and further research.

papers.title: GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion
papers.reason: radar-RGB-D transparent surface segmentation；将雷达与光学传感器的跨模态不一致先验用于海上多传感器目标检测：输入改为船载雷达回波与可见光图像，结构上把雷达引
papers.abstract: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.

papers.title: Multimodal Emergency Vehicle Classification via Audio-Visual Transformers and Knowledge Distillation
papers.reason: 多传感器检测；在雷达-视觉-AIS等多传感器船舶检测中，将空嵌入机制用于缺失的AIS或雷达模态token：当某传感器在部分时段缺失时，用可学习空嵌入替代其token，使统一检测/融合网络在单模态或多模
papers.abstract: Emergency vehicle detection in autonomous driving is a safety-critical perception task that demands robustness under diverse and adverse real-world conditions. Existing approaches rely on a single modality, either audio or video, which leads to systematic failure when that modality is degraded: microphone-based systems fail in noisy urban environments, and camera-based systems fail at night or under occlusion. This report presents AVNet, a multimodal audio-visual transformer that classifies emergency vehicles (ambulance, fire engine, police car) and road background using both audio and video, while gracefully handling the absence of either modality at inference time. AVNet introduces three key contributions: (1) a temporally aligned cross-modal fusion module that performs second-level cross-attention between audio spectrogram tokens and video frame tokens, exploiting their exact temporal correspondence without any learned alignment mechanism; (2) learned null embeddings that substitute for missing modality tokens, enabling a single unified model to operate in audio-only, video-only, or joint audio-visual mode without retraining; and (3) a knowledge distillation training strategy in which specialist unimodal teacher models transfer inter-class dark knowledge into the multimodal student fusion branch via soft probability targets. Evaluated on 281 clips from the Google AudioSet dataset, AVNet achieves 66.6% overall accuracy in audio-visual mode, outperforming the audio-only branch by +10.4% and the video-only branch by +15.0%. The largest per-class gain is observed for the hardest class, Ambulance, where fusion achieves +29.5% over either unimodal branch alone, demonstrating that the two modalities provide complementary information that the aligned cross attention mechanism successfully exploits.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶中的紧急车辆检测是一项安全关键感知任务,要求在多样和不利的现实世界条件下保持稳健. 现有办法依赖单一 模态, 音频或视频,导致系统故障 模态 退化:基于麦克风的系统在吵闹的城市环境中失效,基于相机的系统在夜间或在闭塞下失效. 本报告介绍 AVNet,  多模态 视听 Transformer 紧急车辆(救护车、消防车、警车)和道路背景均使用音频和视频,同时优雅地处理两者之一的缺失 模态 推断时间. AVNet 介绍三项主要贡献: (1) 时间对齐 跨模态 融合 模块,在音频光谱符号和视频帧符号之间进行二级交叉注意,利用它们准确的时空通信,没有学到任何知识 对齐 机制; (2) 已学到的替代缺失的无效嵌入 模态 a. 指示器,使单一的统一模式能够以音频、视频或联合视听模式运作,而无需再培训; (3)  知识蒸馏 将班级间黑暗知识传入 多模态 学生 融合 分支通过软概率目标。 评估 281 来自谷歌的片断 AudioSet 数据集, AVNet 实现 66.6% 音频-视频模式的总体准确性,优于音频分支 +10.4% 和只播放视频的分支 +15.0%. 对最困难的阶层,救护车来说,每班收益最大。 融合 实现 +29.5% 单式分支,证明两者 模态 提供补充信息,说明协调的交叉关注机制成功地利用了.

reserve_papers.title: TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities
reserve_papers.reason: cross_modal_matching；将轻量模态适配模块用于视觉–AIS或Radar–AIS跨模态匹配：保留共享匹配主干，为AIS/雷达增加模态适配层；若无配对真值，可用仿真或按轨迹关联构造合成对
reserve_papers.abstract: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

TartanMatch 调整一个 RGB-pretrained 通信模式 模态 使用轻量级的共享网络中的配对 模态 适应和真实和合成数据的混合。 打开 零样本 现实世界基准, TartanMatch 减少终点错误 (EPE) 超过最强基线 61.9% 用于 跨模态 匹配和 49.6% 用于同一模式的匹配。 我们进一步表明,在所有 模态 配对在配对特定培训中提高平均配对精度,特别是在挑战方面 跨模态 双人 这些结果表明,单一模式可实现广泛的发展。 多模态 覆盖面和最先进的匹配精确度.

reserve_papers.title: ROSETTA: Rotation Subspace Estimation for Training-free Transmodal Alignment
reserve_papers.reason: training-free_transmodal_alignment；将面向LiDAR/相机/热成像/事件跨模态匹配的免训练旋转校准层迁移到视觉–AIS或雷达–AIS跨模态匹配：源域编码器改为船舶视觉
reserve_papers.abstract: When a query must be matched against a database built with a different sensor or processed by a different encoder, the independently trained encoders impose distinct coordinate systems on the feature space. No canonical reference frame exists to which all encoders can be aligned, and no single training procedure has fully closed this gap. We show that the relative transformation between any two such systems is a spatially preserving rotation in whitened feature space, whose angular velocity exhibits white-noise characteristics: large in norm, temporally uncorrelated, and unpredictable from the features themselves. However, the cross-covariance between encoder outputs has low effective rank, constraining only a small fraction of the rotation parameters, therefore local alignment is tractable. ROSETTA is a training-free calibration layer that estimates the local rotation via an expectation-maximization procedure, requiring no coobservation at query time. We validate ROSETTA on three public driving datasets spanning LiDAR, camera, thermal, and event modalities in cross-modal, cross-device, cross-representation, and cross-backbone settings, with milliseconds overhead per query.
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 当一个查询必须与一个用不同传感器建立或由不同编码器处理的数据库相匹配时,独立训练的编码器对特征空间强制实施不同的坐标系统. 不存在可以对所有编码器进行对齐的划线参考框架,也没有单一的训练程序完全堵住了这一缺口. 我们显示,任何两个这样的系统之间的相对转变都是在白化的特征空间中保持空间旋转,其角速显示出白噪声的特征:在规范中很大,时间上不相关,从特征本身来看是不可预测的。 然而,编码器产出之间的相互交错有效级别较低,只限制了轮调参数的一小部分,因此是本地的。 对齐 可拖动. ROSETTA 无训练 校准 层,通过期望最大化程序估计本地旋转,在查询时不需要共同观察。 我们确认 ROSETTA 三个公共驾驶数据集 LiDAR, 相机、热能和事件 模态 在 跨模态, 交叉设备, 交叉-表征, 和交叉背骨设置,每次查询为毫秒.

reserve_papers.title: Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers for Multimodal Anomaly Detection
reserve_papers.reason: 多模态异常检测/跨模态特征对齐；将RGB-点云的双向互相预测对齐改为视觉-雷达/AIS模态间对齐：输入改为船舶图像特征与雷达/AIS时空特征，需设计对应的互补预测目标与轻量适配器微调，对齐损失改为跨模
reserve_papers.abstract: The effective integration of features derived from RGB images and 3D point clouds presents a substantial challenge in the field of multimodal anomaly detection (MAD). Existing MAD methods typically rely on static fusion paradigms built upon frozen pre-trained encoders. While these frameworks facilitate spatial alignment, they lack the mechanism to establish latent semantic correspondence, thereby inducing cross-modal interference that degrades anomaly discriminability. To mitigate these limitations, this study proposes a Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers (BAT) framework, which constructs comprehensive and semantically aligned multimodal representations by leveraging complementary attributes across modalities. The BAT framework introduces a Bidirectional Feature Alignment (BFA) module, which employs a mutual predictive mechanism to bridge the gap between 2D textural patterns and 3D geometric structures. This bidirectional interaction explicitly enhances the textural granularity of point cloud descriptors while augmenting the spatial contextual awareness of RGB features. To ensure that the latent representations possess sufficient informational density for alignment, BAT incorporates a parameter-efficient adaptation architecture. By utilizing lightweight image and point cloud adapters, the framework facilitates specialized fine-tuning of pre-trained models, mitigating the information loss inherent in frozen encoders. Extensive experiments conducted on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies confirm that BAT achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance, significantly outperforming existing MAD methods.
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 有效整合源自于 RGB 图像和 3D 点云 人权领域面临的重大挑战 多模态 异常检测 (MAD). 现有 MAD 方法通常依赖静态 融合 以冷冻的预培训编码器为基础的范式。 虽然这些框架有助于空间 对齐, 它们缺乏建立潜在语义通信的机制,从而诱导 跨模态 干预可降低异常的歧视性。 为减少这些局限性,本研究报告建议采用双向适应方法。 Transformer (BAT) 框架,它构建了全面和整体一致的框架 多模态 表征 利用各种补充性属性 模态.  BAT 框架引入双向特性 对齐 (BFA) 模块,该模块采用一种相互预测机制,以弥合在以下两个方面之间的差距: 2D 纹理图案和 3D 几何结构. 这种双向相互作用明确增强 点云 说明,同时增强空间背景意识 RGB 特性。 确保潜在的 表征 具有足够的信息密度 对齐, BAT 纳入具有参数效率的适应结构。 通过使用轻量级图像和 点云 适配器,框架有利于对预先训练过的模型进行专门微调,减轻冷冻编码器固有的信息损失. 在下列领域进行了广泛的实验: MVTec 3D-AD 眼科医生证实 BAT 达到最新水平 异常检测 业绩,明显超过现有业绩 MAD 方法.

reserve_papers.title: When LiDAR Fades, Radar Takes Over: LiDAR Reliability-Aware Adaptive Localization Under Airborne Obscurants
reserve_papers.reason: LiDAR退化检测与雷达/LiDAR自适应定位；可将LiDAR可靠性估计门控从定位模态切换调整为多传感器检测中的视觉/雷达分支加权或切换：输入改为各传感器检测特征及质量线索，训练目标改为正常/退化状态
reserve_papers.abstract: LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) is widely used for real-time localization and mapping, but its reliability can degrade substantially in subterranean environments affected by smoke, dust, and other airborne obscurants, whereas radar remains comparatively robust. This article presents a one-class temporal learning framework for LiDAR degradation detection and reliability-aware localization under such conditions. A broad set of degradation-sensitive cues, including spatial, cross-modal, geometric/motion, intensity, and measurement-recency features, is evaluated to characterize changes in LiDAR sensing quality. Their temporal evolution is modelled over sliding windows using an LSTM autoencoder trained exclusively on nominal operation, enabling deviations from healthy sensor behaviour to be detected without requiring labelled degradation data. The resulting LiDAR reliability estimate governs adaptive selection between LIO and radar inertial odometry (RIO), retaining LIO during reliable sensing and transferring localization authority to RIO when degradation is detected. The framework is evaluated using real-world ground robot data collected in GNSS-denied subterranean tunnels under nominal and dense-smoke conditions. Experimental results demonstrate degradation detection, adaptive modality switching, and continued localization output under severe LiDAR degradation. A feature family ablation study further shows that a reduced feature representation can improve degradation-aware localization performance in the evaluated dense-smoke scenarios, highlighting the importance of feature parsimony in one-class sensor degradation detection. The code will be released as open source to support reproducibility and further research.

reserve_papers.title: ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection
reserve_papers.reason: RGB-infrared low-light vehicle detection；将RGB-红外两模态可靠性选择与差分恢复机制，调整到雷达/视觉或AIS/视觉多传感器船舶检测：输入改为雷达点云或AIS
reserve_papers.abstract: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared 面向小车辆的检测对于夜间交通监测、应急反应和城市检查十分重要。 光照变化、前光光、局部阴影和热反应退化造成空间差异 模态 可靠性,而车辆的视觉能见度小则会进一步削弱边界、方向提示和热反应。 因此,根据当地 模态 * 可靠性,同时在模棱两可的区域进一步利用补充性歧视性信息 模态 偏好是构建有效 多模态 表征. 基于这一见解,我们提议 ReDiffNet, 可靠性条件差异 表征 网络 模态 可靠性指导证据选择和补充性回收。 具体来说,认识到退化的可靠性的学习估计相对的空间可靠性,以不确定性为指导的差分恢复 跨模态 在模棱两可的区域内恢复补充线索的差异,以及可靠条件的重建,将保留和收回的证据纳入统一的 表征. ReDiffNet 实现 85.3% 和 73.9% mAP50 在 DroneVehicle 和 VEDAI, 分别支持其有效性.

reserve_papers.title: GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion
reserve_papers.reason: radar-RGB-D transparent surface segmentation；将雷达与光学传感器的跨模态不一致先验用于海上多传感器目标检测：输入改为船载雷达回波与可见光图像，结构上把雷达引
reserve_papers.abstract: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 透明表面在建筑环境中无处不在,但仍然是机器人感知的持续失败案例. RGB 相机可以感知玻璃背后的背景,而不是表面本身,而深度传感器,例如: LiDAR, 飞行时间,和 RGB-D 通常返回透明区域的无效或背景测量。 因此,完全依靠光学感知的系统可能会将玻璃墙、门或镜像误解为自由空间,损害安全和可靠的导航。 现有的玻璃分解方法通过学习反射、边界和语义背景等视觉提示来解决这一问题。 RGB 图像。 虽然在有利的照明和取景条件下是有效的,但这些提示在低光度环境中、在光照下或当玻璃表面没有特征或部分被占用时会降解。 在这项工作中,我们建议: 多模态 框架 融合 毫米波雷达 RGB-D 用于实时透明地表分割的传感器. GlassFormer 实现 0.88 mIoU 混合的,和 0.59 mIoU 低光分数,显示大幅增强 视觉-在资源紧张的平台上保持实时性能的同时,只保留基线.

reserve_papers.title: Multimodal Emergency Vehicle Classification via Audio-Visual Transformers and Knowledge Distillation
reserve_papers.reason: 多传感器检测；在雷达-视觉-AIS等多传感器船舶检测中，将空嵌入机制用于缺失的AIS或雷达模态token：当某传感器在部分时段缺失时，用可学习空嵌入替代其token，使统一检测/融合网络在单模态或多模
reserve_papers.abstract: Emergency vehicle detection in autonomous driving is a safety-critical perception task that demands robustness under diverse and adverse real-world conditions. Existing approaches rely on a single modality, either audio or video, which leads to systematic failure when that modality is degraded: microphone-based systems fail in noisy urban environments, and camera-based systems fail at night or under occlusion. This report presents AVNet, a multimodal audio-visual transformer that classifies emergency vehicles (ambulance, fire engine, police car) and road background using both audio and video, while gracefully handling the absence of either modality at inference time. AVNet introduces three key contributions: (1) a temporally aligned cross-modal fusion module that performs second-level cross-attention between audio spectrogram tokens and video frame tokens, exploiting their exact temporal correspondence without any learned alignment mechanism; (2) learned null embeddings that substitute for missing modality tokens, enabling a single unified model to operate in audio-only, video-only, or joint audio-visual mode without retraining; and (3) a knowledge distillation training strategy in which specialist unimodal teacher models transfer inter-class dark knowledge into the multimodal student fusion branch via soft probability targets. Evaluated on 281 clips from the Google AudioSet dataset, AVNet achieves 66.6% overall accuracy in audio-visual mode, outperforming the audio-only branch by +10.4% and the video-only branch by +15.0%. The largest per-class gain is observed for the hardest class, Ambulance, where fusion achieves +29.5% over either unimodal branch alone, demonstrating that the two modalities provide complementary information that the aligned cross attention mechanism successfully exploits.
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶中的紧急车辆检测是一项安全关键感知任务,要求在多样和不利的现实世界条件下保持稳健. 现有办法依赖单一 模态, 音频或视频,导致系统故障 模态 退化:基于麦克风的系统在吵闹的城市环境中失效,基于相机的系统在夜间或在闭塞下失效. 本报告介绍 AVNet,  多模态 视听 Transformer 紧急车辆(救护车、消防车、警车)和道路背景均使用音频和视频,同时优雅地处理两者之一的缺失 模态 推断时间. AVNet 介绍三项主要贡献: (1) 时间对齐 跨模态 融合 模块,在音频光谱符号和视频帧符号之间进行二级交叉注意,利用它们准确的时空通信,没有学到任何知识 对齐 机制; (2) 已学到的替代缺失的无效嵌入 模态 a. 指示器,使单一的统一模式能够以音频、视频或联合视听模式运作,而无需再培训; (3)  知识蒸馏 将班级间黑暗知识传入 多模态 学生 融合 分支通过软概率目标。 评估 281 来自谷歌的片断 AudioSet 数据集, AVNet 实现 66.6% 音频-视频模式的总体准确性,优于音频分支 +10.4% 和只播放视频的分支 +15.0%. 对最困难的阶层,救护车来说,每班收益最大。 融合 实现 +29.5% 单式分支,证明两者 模态 提供补充信息,说明协调的交叉关注机制成功地利用了.
